hook.text: A person donates to charity only to impress a date. Another donates out of genuine compassion.

buildup.text: Virtue ethics judges character, not just actions or outcomes.

discovery.text: Aristotle taught that virtues are habits.

twist.text: The weakness of virtue ethics is vagueness. What counts as a virtue changes across cultures and eras.

climax.text: Ask what kind of person do I want to be? instead of what should I do in this situation? Character shapes countless.

punchline.text: Build character. Good actions follow from good habits.

quiz.question: What does virtue ethics focus on?
